summary: No holding's thesis was broken by news today. There is no 8-K, 10-Q or 10-K on any of the 14 held names in the 7-day window, so no 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or 1.01/2.01 to read (L2 check done for every holding, below). The day's story was the Nvidia escalation: the 11-09 probe and the 11-10 affair reports became a report that the board is weighing Huang's removal, with CFO Kress as possible interim CEO. NVDA fell about 8% premarket, five sessions before its 11-17 print. The book absorbed it. Equity fell $1.21 (about -0.19%) against SPY about -0.35%. VOO (-0.29%) and VTI (-0.42%) stayed 3.9% above the SPY 200-day stop line, and the staples sheltered on this day (DPZ +1.42%, KR +0.46%, WMT +0.31%). The weak spot was not news. The bond and rate sleeves fell on a risk-off equity day (IEF -0.84%, BND -0.62%, VNQ -0.60%), which is the CPI/December-hike thread from 11-10 still working with no new datum today. IEF closed 0.8% above its $89.50 stop and BND 0.9% above its $70.00 stop. Either can trip on an ordinary day, and that is a price event the PM should expect, not a news call. Event threads closed today: TTEK reported 11-11 after the close (8-K 2.02/8.01/9.01 filed 11-12) with a beat (adj EPS $0.49 vs $0.47, sales $1.340B vs $1.151B), FY27 EPS guide $1.65-$1.80 bracketing the $1.71 estimate and a slightly soft Q1, and traded up about 8.5% premarket, so the 11-11 high-risk flag resolved to the upside (not held by the agent; a shadow holding). MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy from its indexes, which settles the crypto-treasury index decision flagged since 11-10. Strategy fell about 6% and bitcoin went below $73K. This matters for BTC sentiment, not for held MSCI (-1.5% on the day, no company filing). The agent holds no crypto.

memory_followups.followup: The 11-09 to 11-11 earnings flags resolved: the print beat, guidance roughly matched estimates, and the stock rose about 8.5% premarket. The event was real and the reaction was positive. Baird kept Neutral and raised its PT to $40.

The MSCI crypto-treasury decision (dated catalyst since 11-10) came out as a removal for Strategy. Bitcoin lost $73K on the same morning as the Nvidia news. The 11-05 to 11-11 downside warnings keep playing out. No exchange failure. Not held by the agent.

I cut QQQ to medium on 11-11, and the Nvidia story escalated the next morning. The board is reportedly weighing Huang's removal, and 11-17 is now an earnings date plus a governance event. VOO/VTI took it in stride on the day, so the medium rating held for the held index sleeves.
The file's 11-12 estimate came and went with no event, as flagged. SBH reported 11-10. Canaccord raised its PT to $25 (Buy).
The M&A chatter came back on 11-11 ('Watching Clorox Shares; Traders Circulate M&A Chatter'), a second day. Still no filing or named source.
Second PT cut in three sessions (Wells Fargo to $112 from $123, Overweight kept, after Argus $105). Negative sell-side drift after the 11-04 print. Not held.
